doc: The unit direction of a vortex center from its (lon, lat) in radians: both poles, longitudes +pi and -pi (the antimeridian: cos is -1 and sin is +-1.2e-16), signed zeros, longitudes beyond +-pi. Float64 libm cos and sin (correctly rounded to 1 ulp): rtol 1e-9, atol 1e-14 for the 6e-17 of cos(pi/2). Conventions of cloudgen.sphere read here: lonlat_to_dir(lon, lat) = (cos lat cos lon, cos lat sin lon, sin lat) with float64 numpy cos and sin (right-handed, z north, longitude grows east; a vortex center is that direction); normalize(v) = v / |v| (plain division, no epsilon: a zero vector gives NaN). A pseudo-function name: there is nothing to call, the port maps it by hand. (a property: the port maps it to its own center function).
